about: Gut ratings of hikes routes offered (the Trailhead Gut Check, routes#95's anti-oracle): would a person pick this hike? verdict good/meh/bad, category multi = better as an overnight trip than a day hike. Each with the hike as routes proposed it then (its candidate record: line, score parts, route).
